purpose: Replace Keycloak references and identity-sync projections with local Argon2id credentials and monotonic account security revisions.
lockImpact: Rewrites the account identity boundary, creates password_credentials, validates the required person association, and drops identity_sync_operations.
dataImpact: Destructive local-development reset. Existing Keycloak links and identity-sync projections are removed; no password can be derived from prior identity data.
backfill: Not supported. Reset the local database and create the initial system administrator through the reviewed bootstrap command.
destructiveApproval: Approved by ADR-0034 and the 2026-08-04 local-development empty-volume reset; no retained environment data exists.
recovery: Restore the complete pre-reset database backup and prior application version. Local password hashes cannot be converted to Keycloak credentials.
forwardFix: Append a reviewed workforce-access-owned migration. Do not rewrite this migration after application.
